metric_or_event: 未确认税收利益滚动额及有效税率子集
raw_value: Unrecognized tax benefits, end of period: $953m (2026), $1,026m (2025), $990m (2024). FY2026 gross total excludes related interest and penalties; $742m would affect the effective tax rate if recognized in future periods. Majority is long-term and included in Deferred income taxes and other liabilities. The company estimates gross unrecognized tax benefits could decrease by up to $184m from expected resolution of certain 2017-2019 IRS matters.
source_location: FY2026 10-K Note 7 Income Taxes original p.74 (PDF physical p.78); audit critical matter discussion original p.54 (physical p.58).
calculation_bridge: 742是953的税率影响子集；953/1,026/990为各期末总额，不能替代或相加。

metric_or_event: IEEPA关税回收、已收金额与应收款
raw_value: After the February 20, 2026 Supreme Court ruling described in the 10-K, NIKE deemed recovery of IEEPA tariffs paid probable in Q4 FY2026 and recognized a $986m benefit in Cost of sales: $965m North America and $21m Converse. At May 31, 2026 it had received $302m and recorded $684m outstanding IEEPA tariff receivables in Accounts receivable, net. Subsequent to May 31 it received substantially all of the remaining receivable.
source_location: FY2026 10-K MD&A Other Matters original p.30 (PDF physical p.34); Note 1 original p.61 (physical p.65).
calculation_bridge: 986=965+21；302+684=986（USD millions）。后续实际回款精确日期和金额未披露。

metric_or_event: FY2026资本开支、分红、回购及授权余额
raw_value: Cash additions to PP&E: $812m, $430m, $684m in FY2024-FY2026; non-cash additions $160m, $184m, $174m. Dividends $2,169m, $2,300m, $2,407m; repurchase cash outflows $4,250m, $2,985m, $146m. June 2022 $18bn Class B repurchase authorization was reapproved in June 2026 without aggregate increase; about $12.1bn spent and $5.9bn remained at May 31, 2026.
source_location: FY2026 10-K cash flows original p.58; Item 5 original p.26; liquidity original p.45.

metric_or_event: 承诺、普通法律事项与比利时海关索赔
raw_value: Outstanding bank guarantees and letters of credit were approximately $1.3bn at May 31, 2026, primarily for real estate agreements, self-insurance, other business obligations and legal matters. Company is subject to legal proceedings, claims and government investigations including customs and tax matters. Management did not believe pending matters would materially adversely affect results, financial position or cash flows except as described. Belgian Customs alleges underpaid duties on products imported beginning FY2018; company disputes and is in appeal, issued bank guarantees, cannot estimate loss range, and says adverse resolution could materially affect results, financial position and cash flows.
normalized_unit: USD billions; null where not disclosed
source_location: FY2026 10-K Note 16 Commitments and Contingencies original p.88 (PDF physical p.92); Item 3 Legal Proceedings original p.25.
calculation_bridge: 比利时海关索赔金额与损失区间均未披露，保留null。
